correctness.rationale: Headline has two parts: (i) primitive-point log BPS m^P_{-K}=10 with eta=0, (ii) w_out=1<2 mixing/ill-posedness. Numerics replayed: K^2=9-7=2, w=(-K).E=2, p_a=(-K.0)/2+1=1, e(P2)+7=10, all exact; scripts verify_emergent.py -> EMERGENT_VERIFY_OK and check_dP2_numerics.py -> VERIFY_OK replayed locally. eta=0 proof is correct: any line l has l^2=-1, p_a=0, so by adjunction -2=-1+l.K, l.K=-1, (-K).l=1 !=0 for every line, so no line orthogonal to beta=-K. Hence eta=0 without enumerating 56 lines. Existence of beta-primitive P for general (X,E): w=2, Z/2xZ/2 has order-2 elements; matches Choi et al. Prop existence / Lemma 4.10-4.11. Since beta=-K is primitive as a class, for general pair every P in E(beta) is primitive (no k>1 splitting). Applicability citation is to Choi-van Garrel-Katz-Takahashi Thm 5.2(2)/Thm 1.11: del Pezzo S, beta line/conic/nef-big, p_a=1, beta != -K_S8 => m^P=e(S)-eta. S7=dP2 is del Pezzo, beta=-K ample hence nef-big with integral member, p_a=1, not S8, so hypothesis satisfied on statement level; e-eta=10. DRAFT honestly withholds total N=40 (needs unproven Conj 1 P-independence for this class) and withholds any scattering computation. w_out=1 arithmetic is correct (lines have E.l=1). Qualitative mixing gloss (global log f_out sums over all classes, local KS order-2 commutator c=|det| always resolvable) is directionally true and no false integer is asserted. Distinction: scripts prove only integer identities; enumerative content is by citation to peer-reviewed theorem, not by computation. No essential computation error found. Very-ample edge (beta=-K_S7 ample but not very ample, excluded from Lemma 4.5/Cor 4.19) is a residual proof-dependence risk but does not falsify the stated formula, which is the published theorem conclusion. Hence correctness PASSES as correct corollary + correct arithmetic.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified as genuinely target-derived (same pair (dP2,E), same class beta=-K, invariant side of audit step 4 + structural reason steps 1-3 blocked), not a convenient replacement; no preset-value presumption applied. Fused live search (3 normalized forms in one scope_literature_search call, no partial failure) + full-text comparison shows headline count is substantively implied by strictly stronger prior theorem. Choi et al. arXiv:1810.02377 Thm 5.2(2) (summarized as Thm 1.11): for any del Pezzo S, smooth anticanonical E, beta line/conic/nef-big with p_a=1 and beta != -K_S8, m^P=e(S)-eta at primitive P. S7 with beta=-K satisfies all hypotheses (ample=>nef-big, p_a=1, not S8), e=10, eta=0 by adjunction above, so m^P=10 follows by substitution. Prior need not state 'S7 -K 10' verbatim; it exhaustively covers it. DRAFT's novelty claim ('not tabulated, Thm 1 covers only line/conic/dh') confuses Thm 1.4 (P-independence/Conj 1.3, proved only for multiples of lines/conics/dh) with Thm 5.2/1.11 (primitive-point calculation, proved for all nef-big p_a<=1). The mixing part (w_out=1, x^2 mixes 2l/conics/-K) is standard wall-sum structure plus trivial line intersection, not a new lemma. See decisive_checks.

value.rationale: Judged strongest headline separately from blocked target survey. The exact datum m^P=10 is a mere parameter substitution into published general formula e(S)-eta: e=10 textbook, eta=0 one-line adjunction. It is mechanically implied, computable in seconds by any future researcher from the stronger theorem, not a previously unknown invariant requiring new computation. Fails the exact-invariant test (motivated object yes, but value mechanically implied, no new method). Mixing observation w_out=1<2 is a target-failure explanation (why literal single-class chamber equation cannot isolate N_{-K}), not an independently retrievable enumerative benchmark; global wall formula already sums over all classes, and no new scattering object is constructed. No downstream DT/cluster use needs the isolated '10' beyond the general formula; no correction term with coefficient is proved. Hence textbook restatement / corollary repackaging with no independent retrieval value. FAIL.
